items.title: Dadaocheng / Dihua Street — Yongle Market, Dry Goods, Tea
items.hours: Mon Nov 30: Yongle Market 1F fresh market CLOSED (Monday closure, waived only on lunar 1st/2nd/15th/16th; Nov 30 is lunar 10/22). 2F–3F fabric floors 09:00–18:00 (closed Sundays only), so open on arrival. Wang Tea Dadaocheng shop: Mon–Sat 09:00–18:00.
items.cost: Free to browse. Wang Tea factory guided tour (bookable): NT$4,000 per session for up to 20 people, NT$200 each beyond 20; about 20–30 min.
items.getThere: MRT Green Line to Beimen (G13, 塔城街10號); Exit 3 (with elevator) is at the SW corner of Tacheng St / Zhengzhou Rd. Yongle Market is at 迪化街一段21號; buses listed by the Taipei Market Administration: 9, Red 25, 206, 250, 255, 274, 302, 660, 669.
highlights: Yongle Market (迪化街一段21號): head straight up to 2F–3F, the fabric floors of the building (market dates to 1908; current complex opened 1985).
Wang Tea 有記名茶 (重慶北路二段64巷26號): a working refined-tea factory since c.1947 — shop in front, traditional charcoal-roasting pits and basket-roasting room behind.
Wang Tea range to taste: Wenshan pouchong, high-mountain oolong, Chi Chong oolong, tieguanyin, Oriental Beauty, green and black teas.
Lin Hua Tai Tea 林華泰茶行: founded 1883, one of Taipei's oldest tea merchants; wholesale and retail.
tips: With 1F shut there are no market-floor food stalls inside the building today; eat breakfast on the street.
Lin Hua Tai has a single shop and no branches, and warns that imposters online use its name with other addresses and phone numbers.
Fabric-floor phones if you need to check: 2F 02-2558-4858, 3F 02-2558-8846.
items.watch: Yongle Market 1F is closed on Mondays. Wang Tea closes Sundays only (open today).

items.title: Early Lunch — Traditional Dadaocheng / Wanhua Corridor
items.getThere: 賣麵炎仔 (Mai Mien Yen Tsai, aka 金泉小吃) at 安西街106號, beside the side gate of Yongle Elementary School; from MRT Daqiaotou Exit 1 it is about a 5-minute walk.
highlights: Signature 紅燒肉: red-fermented pork deep-fried crisp outside, tender inside, served with sweet-chili/soy sauce; it usually appears a little after 9 AM.
湯麵 (plain soup noodles) in a stock of chicken, pork and pork offal.
下水湯 offal soup (liver, heart, kidney) and boiled chicken — order these plus the pork for the protein target, noodles as the side.
tips: The menu shows no prices; order with staff at the door, who then seat you.
One reviewer found the dry noodles (乾麵) very salty and recommends the soup noodles instead.
There is a queue most days and it grows toward noon — the 10:00 slot is the right call.
items.watch: No official website or loadable Michelin page was available to verify hours or prices; food blogs report cash only. Bring cash and confirm opening that morning (phone 02-2557-7087).

items.title: Qingshan Festival — Pass 1 (Main Procession Day)
items.hours: Confirmed: Mon Nov 30 2026 = lunar 10/22, the main procession day (正日遶境). Troupes assemble and set off 09:00 from 大理街170巷口; the Lingan Zunwang palanquin departs 11:00. No official end or return time is published.
items.getThere: MRT Blue (Bannan) Line to Longshan Temple BL10; Exit 1 (elevator) is at Heping W Rd Sec 3 / Xiyuan Rd Sec 1. Qingshan Temple: 貴陽街二段218號. The temple recommends public transport via Longshan Temple station.
highlights: The Nov 30 route links south and north Wanhua. On the official map, red arrows show troupe direction and green dashed arrows mark troupe assembly stretches.
Ritual order: the Eight Generals (八將, the god's guard) enter the temple to invite him out before the palanquin starts; route placards, regalia, generals and bearers each have set roles.
Main day is the birthday celebration with allied temples and extra troupes; household altars and red stages line the route to receive the god.
Registered Taipei folk cultural heritage (2010) and one of the city's three great temple festivals.
tips: To see troupes form up and the palanquin leave, be at the 大理街170巷口 assembly point before 11:00, then shadow the route.
The god's birthday itself is lunar 10/23 = Tue Dec 1; Nov 28 and 29 were the south and north Wanhua night patrols.
The 藝閣 float parade ran only on Nov 28 (19:30) and Nov 29 (19:00) from Hangzhou S Rd — don't expect floats on Nov 30.
Temple phone 02-2382-2296; route text and maps were posted Oct 20 on the temple site and its Facebook page (qingshantemple).
items.watch: The temple's map shows the procession route, not road-closure times or parking — expect blocked streets and don't rely on cars along it.

items.title: Wanhua / Nanjichang Food Break
items.hours: Nanjichang (Ln 307–315, Sec 2 Zhonghua Rd) is listed Mon–Sun 06:00–24:00. Open at 3:30 PM Monday: 曉迪筒仔米糕 11:00–22:00 (closed Sat) and 山內雞肉 11:00–21:00 (closed Sat).
items.cost: 曉迪: braised pork rice NT$35, tube rice cake NT$45, braised pork belly or rib NT$70, trotter NT$90, egg/tofu NT$15, rib soups NT$60. 山內: chicken rice NT$130, thigh rice NT$140, skin-on shank rice NT$120, chicken soup NT$150.
items.getThere: The market occupies Lanes 307 to 315 off Sec 2 Zhonghua Rd, Zhongzheng District, at the Wanhua edge.
highlights: High-protein order at 曉迪: 滷控肉 or 滷排骨 (NT$70 each) with a braised egg, plus the signature 筒仔米糕.
山內雞肉: whole chickens cooked fresh daily and chilled; boneless tender thigh rice (NT$140) comes with chicken-fat rice and angelica chicken soup.
Nanjichang has six Michelin Bib Gourmand stalls and many family stalls of 30+ years, per the Ministry of Economic Affairs market site.
tips: The app's 'Xiaodi rice cake' is 曉迪筒仔米糕 (Xiao Di Tube-Shaped Sticky Rice).
A 2026 report names 臭老闆現蒸臭豆腐 (freshly steamed stinky tofu) among the market's known shops.
Prices are vendor-supplied to the government site; on-site boards prevail.
items.watch: Urban renewal: Units 3 and 4 (both sides of Lane 307) are signed; Unit 4 plan submission is expected in H2 2027. Only stalls next to Units 4/5 must move outside hoarding during works. Some shops may still change, so check each stall that day.

items.title: Qingshan Festival — Pass 3 (Optional, Night)
items.hours: No official end time is published for the Nov 30 procession. Backup E7PLAY Sanchong is open 24 hours, every day of the year.
items.cost: E7PLAY weekday rate (all day Monday), non-member, per person: 3 h NT$290 if you enter 11:00–23:00 or NT$230 if 23:00–07:00; 5 h NT$330 / NT$270. Add 10% cleaning fee. Overtime NT$30 per 30 min.
items.getThere: E7PLAY: B1–B3, 新北市三重區中央南路63號, next to MRT Taipei Bridge station and near Sanhe Night Market; enter the lane at the Shin Kong Bank corner. Taxi there from Wanhua per the plan.
highlights: One ticket covers bowling (including glow lanes), pool, electronic darts, phone-booth KTV, board games, massage-chair rooms and arcade machines that need no tokens.
Listed arcade titles include Taiko no Tatsujin 14, maimai, Initial D 8, boxing and basketball machines.
tips: Bowling: show your ticket at the counter. A lane is set for 30 min and extended in 15-min blocks while lanes are free; if all are full, re-book at the counter.
Darts, massage rooms and KTV need photo ID plus your ticket, so carry passports.
Pay by Visa, Mastercard or JCB card, LINE Pay or TWQR. Outside food is allowed.
items.watch: Bopiliao Historic Block is closed every Monday (street block and indoor exhibits), so it is not an evening fallback. The city arts showcase at Bopiliao and Ximen Exit 6 ran Nov 29 only.

items.title: Wanhua Dinner
items.hours: Still open after 22:15 on a Monday at Nanjichang: 好吃鹽水雞 17:00–24:00; 勳章滷味 17:00–23:30 (occasional closures); 八棟圓仔湯 15:00–24:00 (occasional closures). 曉迪 (to 22:00) and 山內 (to 21:00) will already be shut.
items.cost: 鹽水雞: chicken breast NT$70, leg NT$85, half chicken NT$160. 勳章: beef shank NT$68, beef tendon NT$68, chicken thigh NT$58. 八棟 desserts NT$60–120 (peanut soup NT$75, fermented-rice egg soup NT$65).
items.getThere: Same market as the afternoon stop: Lanes 307–315, Sec 2 Zhonghua Rd.
highlights: Best late protein: 好吃鹽水雞 chicken breast (NT$70), or set 3 — half chicken with six sides (NT$260) to share.
勳章滷味: braised beef shank and tendon, pork shank, chicken thigh; braised without preservatives.
Dessert at 八棟圓仔湯 (since 1977): peanut soup, red-bean mini tangyuan, fermented-rice egg soup, white fungus & lotus seed soup.
tips: If you are near Longshan Temple before 22:00, 龍都冰菓專業家 (和平西路3段192號) is open Monday 11:30–22:00 (closed Wednesdays).
Two of these stalls list occasional closures; keep a second option.
items.watch: Stall hours and prices are vendor-supplied to the government site; on-site boards prevail. 龍都 closes at 22:00.

items.title: Back to Via Hotel
items.getThere: Via Hotel Taipei Station, No. 60 Sec 1 Chongqing S Rd. MRT option: Blue Line from Longshan Temple (BL10) 2 stops via Ximen (BL11) to Taipei Main Station (BL12), Exit Z10, then 8–10 min walk along Chongqing S Rd. Or Red Line to NTU Hospital Exit 4, 5–7 min walk through the park.
tips: For a taxi, walk off the procession route first; the official route map is not a road-closure plan.
items.watch: Last-train times were not readable on the Metro site; check the Taipei Metro app before relying on the MRT late.
